design: One fresh batch review session per condition; no independent sessions per case. A candidate preflight was also retained.
model: Inherited Codex collaboration model; exact backend model identifier and sampling configuration were not exposed.
grader: Independent grading agent using condition aliases, followed by primary-agent inspection; no human adjudication.
tools: Local packet reads and response writes only; no browsing, no compilation by evaluated agents.
usage_metrics: No token, latency, or cost instrumentation; byte sizes are file metadata only.
preflight_note: The candidate preflight predates a source-anchor correction (flat-file-layout to structure) and addition of public Rust fallback links. The final candidate was evaluated in a fresh session. Preflight raw responses and manifest are retained; no failed run was discarded.
